watch.summary: The creator reacts with disbelief and mock commentary to a terrible push by a professional Valorant player during a match.

beats.what: Creator watches pro Valorant match footage with on-screen text.
A team gets completely wiped out during a push in the match.
Creator begins roasting the player, asking 'What was Mada thinking?'
Creator hilariously imitates Mada's internal logic about stunning and spraying.
Creator concludes that Mada was thinking 'absolutely nothing, bro.'

watch.author: creator
watch.why: The creator's animated roasting and exaggerated voice act as an entertaining breakdown of a chaotic pro gaming mistake. Without knowledge of Valorant, a viewer might not fully grasp why the play was so egregiously bad.
